caveats: Officer Rodney Vicknair sexually assaulted a 14-year-old rape survivor he had transported for a rape exam (2020). Civil suit filed by victim's mother in federal court in February 2021 (The Appeal) against Vicknair and City of New Orleans - note slug says 2022 but source says Feb 2021. Vicknair pleaded guilty to a federal civil rights charge (Nov 2022) and was sentenced March 14, 2023 to 14 years.
